title: Logische CPUs kontrolliert offline und online schalten

dependencies.hash_source: exact published public commit archive, zig fetch exit0
dependencies.reason: New optional lifecycle methods require SDK40 for standalone builds; existing older table prefixes remain supported.

owner: Physical AP/IRQ/TLB/FPU/scheduler lifecycle necessarily belongs to Kernel. Explicit diagnostic belongs to Spectra; CLI control/passive display to existing SysInfo; append-only contracts and facades to Contract/SDK. No new module/repository.

implementation.states: Existing0..8 retained; draining9,parked10,offline11,stop-pending12 appended. Schedulable membership and TLB-participant membership separate.
implementation.ownership: Single bounded writer vs CPU-sensitive diagnostic leases, task lifetime pinned separately. Controller must have immutable BSP eligibility, enabled IF and no ranked/runtime owner. A temporarily CPU0-bound Compute task is insufficient.
implementation.drain: Bounded registry preflight preserves requested/applied hard sets. Fixed/unsafe Kernel tasks, unfinished resource release or missing exact receipts return Busy. Saved Ready/Blocked continuations retain wait/timeout/FPU/generation/FIFO/budgets; running task moves only after the physical saved RSP/FPU boundary.
implementation.irq: Actual MSI/MSI-X records and every physical IOAPIC redirection entry inspected/verified. Delivery/remote-IRR Busy; preserve masks/original firmware teardown data. Readback/rollback and exact checked receiver hint; uncertain state retained. CF8/CFC pairs and write16 RMW share a new rank85 leaf PCI owner, preserving IF.
implementation.park: Actual permanent AP idle stack, no module/current work or held owners, exact stopped localtimer token, clean FPU and full/global TLB flush. Park polls only independent resident TLB, exact cancel or terminal stop.
implementation.withdraw: PageOwner6 verifies actual last TLB generation/ACK, withdraws enrollment, then exact IRQ/park/withdraw/stop epoch becomes stopped. Retired receipt only after topology/PAT/clock withdrawals. Unconfirmed post-withdraw stop remains quarantined, never forced online or freed.
implementation.online: Exact reusable stopped receipt; checked epoch advance and genuine INIT/SIPI. Fresh local tables/CPUID/XCR0/FPU/PAT/clock/topology/admission. Immutable discovery must match; changed facts refuse. Final full/global flush and enrollment serialized under existing Runtime then PageOwner6, without held owner while waiting. Old ACKs cannot release new epochs.
implementation.terminal: System shutdown closes lifecycle, including parked/stop-pending CPUs; terminal stop cannot be reused. Stale F1 does not invent a terminal request.
implementation.abi: Old R4DEV67 slots/552 bytes unchanged, two optional slots appended at552/560, full568. New versioned128B CpuLifecycleInfo and native report. Error paths preserve outputs/tails; older providers explicitly unavailable.
implementation.standard: Optional passive capacity-generation checks outside sample timing detect an offline/online cycle even if count returns. Suite3 workload, fixed reference and scoring unchanged.
implementation.presentation: Runtime PAT/SMP requalification goes to retained bootlog only, preserving structured caller output; cold boot console unchanged. Explicit PCI diagnostic emits one actual serial span plus bootlog. offline_cycles is an always-visible event count, not optional TSC detail.

message.text: SPECTRA CPU lifecycle: ok (native Busy/IF/TLB, real module YMM/wait migration, I/O and fresh epochs)
Passive counters since boot; owner loads are not one atomic snapshot. No workload or historical check pass is implied.
CPU topology uses full boot identities and opaque package/core keys; advertised domain bounds are not schedulable capacity. Unknown geometry keeps the flat fallback.
Isolated boot cases: timer reprogramming, deterministic 64+1 timeout batch, reserve OOM injection, global boot priority latency.

native.limits: Logical reuse of already boot-admitted CPUs only. Actual KVM4, available3 during offline, four configured always. No physical hotplug, native>4 lifecycle, CPU-power measurement or scaling claim.

standard.limits: Exactly one complete final normal-build observation. Logical CPU restart correctness is qualified separately in the scoped native lifecycle guest. No score-selection rerun, workload/scoring modification or universal/native speedup claim.

preserved_failures: Second final candidate passed all new CPU cases and original heap/scheduler/placement but last strict WORKERS returned compute lifecycle failure without a stage. No pass was claimed. Original consumer also demonstrably treated a documented transient global inventory cursor restart as failure after child completion: exact old source countercase reproduced, corrected actual consumer passes five stateful host cases including retained-owner/error/perpetual-restart refusal. Added failure-stage records; final native success is required separately.

First final candidate passed all twelve commands but original marker parser rejected eleven vs historical ten owner classes. Exact new eleven expectation and stale-ten countercase added; existing Clock4/SMP4 selftests passed. Runtime raw qualification lines had interleaved queued caller JSON and PCI proof was bootring-only; source routes corrected before final rerun and before any STANDARD. Exact candidate source predecessors, frozen inputs and binary preserved.

Initial and second WIP guests correctly refused unsafe AP caller context before CPU mutation. Raw logs and exact old Kernel/probe binaries retained; tiny noncanonical BSP probe localized module launch role. Final Spectra explicitly launches a real foreground BSP child and requires success-only file after true joins, not the legacy completion-only return code.

Initial local zig fetch dot recursively encountered its own package cache (NameTooLong). Empty-hash guard prevented pin mutation. Published commit archive fetched/verified, both consumer pins rebuilt; only exact own failed22GB temporary cache reclaimed with no-FD/cwd proof.
limits: KVM SMP4 only. Always four configured CPUs; three genuinely schedulable while CPU1 offline. No physical hot-add/hot-remove, remote/native target or greater-than-four lifecycle qualification.
Logical offline is not a guaranteed physical power-off or energy-saving result. BSP0 remains online; fixed/unsafe or uncertain resources deliberately prevent withdrawal.
Unconfirmed stop/IRQ/rollback/qualification retains exact owners and can leave CPU unavailable until reboot; Busy is not permission to force reuse.
Native>32 capacity remains separately unqualified as documented in0.85.22.

QEMU live device IRQs stayed on their original other receivers (module drain irq_retargets0); real hardware MSI/MSI-X retarget from an offlined AP was not exercised. Ten actual-source peer fixtures cover handover/rollback/uncertainty separately, not physical-device qualification.
One final all4 STANDARD observation/full unchanged readback is not an isolated performance or scaling claim.
